_about: The roguelike march: economy, evolution and fusion recipes, fort upgrades, rewards, the seven-stop route and the rival commanders. Every number of the campaign lives here; src/run/*.ts only reads it.
_starBonus: [attack, health] added at 1, 2 and 3 stars. Stars survive evolution.
_costs: train[i]: from i+1 stars to i+2. evolve[i]: from form i+1 to i+2. fuse: two regiments (both form II or higher, different families) become one hybrid regiment at the lower of their stars.

gates.name: Iron Gate
gates.text: Strikes back 1 at every unit that hits your Fort. +2 max health.

rewards.label: Drill Sergeant
rewards.text: A free star for your best regiment that can still train.

rewards.label: Volunteers
rewards.text: A free new regiment of a family you lack (replaces a Levy if your army is full).

rewards.label: Arrow Volley
rewards.text: Add Arrow Volley to your deck.

rewards.label: War Horn
rewards.text: Add War Horn to your deck.

rewards.label: Fire Pots
rewards.text: Add Fire Pots to your deck.

rewards.label: Mend the Walls
rewards.text: Add Mend the Walls to your deck.

rewards.label: Ring the Bell
rewards.text: Add Ring the Bell to your deck.

weatherText.varsha: Rain and mud: no unit can advance and attack in the same turn.
weatherText.grishma: Heat haze: ranged units deal 1 less damage (never less than 1).
weatherText.hemanta: Harvest fair: both sides have 1 extra Supply every turn.

nera.name: Nera Vale
nera.title: River Courier
nera.intro: Nera carries letters across every ford in the Marches. She holds her riders back for the last muster, then floods the far bank.

sella.name: Sella Yew
sella.title: Orchard Warden
sella.intro: Sella keeps a plain lead in front of her best archers. Break the lead and the bows are bare.

brann.name: Brann Holt
brann.title: Master of the Rivet Yard
brann.intro: Brann's smiths rivet armour onto anyone who will stand still. His guards are slow, and very hard to kill.

tamsin.name: Tamsin Reed
tamsin.title: Toll-Keeper
tamsin.intro: Tamsin charges a toll in silver or in blood. Her horse archers have never paid one.

odo.name: Odo Marl
odo.title: Copper Captain
odo.intro: Odo pays his pikemen in copper and his lancers in gold. Both earn it.

anvil.name: The Anvil Warden
anvil.title: Keeper of the Court
anvil.intro: Behind stone walls and an iron gate, the Warden waits for you to break yourself on them.

kestrel.name: Kestrel
kestrel.title: Rider of the High Road
kestrel.intro: Kestrel has knights where others have farmhands. Every charge is meant to end the duel.

amber.name: The Amber Regent
amber.title: Lord of the Pass
amber.intro: Towers line the Amber Pass. The Regent's rangers vanish into the smoke between them.

silas.name: Silas Crane
silas.title: Crown Marshal
silas.intro: The Marshal was sent to stop you reaching the Bell. He brought the Crown's best.

orra.name: Keeper Orra
orra.title: Keeper of the Fifth Bell
orra.intro: A dented copper bell hangs at Orra's belt. Her guard standard tells you what she fields. When she rings it, you will know what she intends.
